top_signals.title: BMW Offers Buyouts to Thousands of German Workers to Cut Costs
top_signals.summary: BMW AG is offering voluntary severance packages to thousands of its workers in Germany, as the carmaker tries to become leaner to better compete with rivals from China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
